package fixture

import (
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	"github.com/mia0x75/parserkit/loc"
)

type tokenSpan struct {
	token int
	span  loc.Span
}

type lexer struct {
	tokens []tokenSpan
	spans  []loc.Span
	err    string
}

func (l *lexer) Lex(val *yySymType) int {
	val.span = loc.InvalidSpan()
	if len(l.tokens) == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	tok := l.tokens[0]
	l.tokens = l.tokens[1:]
	val.span = tok.span
	return tok.token
}

func (l *lexer) Error(message string) { l.err = message }

func TestGeneratedReductionSpans(t *testing.T) {
	unknown := loc.InvalidSpan()
	tests := []struct {
		name   string
		tokens []tokenSpan
		want   []loc.Span
	}{
		{name: "epsilon", want: []loc.Span{unknown, unknown}},
		{name: "known empty token", tokens: []tokenSpan{{ATOM, loc.Span{}}}, want: []loc.Span{{}, unknown, {}}},
		{name: "unknown token", tokens: []tokenSpan{{ATOM, unknown}}, want: []loc.Span{unknown, unknown, unknown}},
		{name: "full RHS and trailing epsilon", tokens: []tokenSpan{{ATOM, loc.Span{Start: 2, End: 3}}, {ATOM, loc.Span{Start: 6, End: 7}}}, want: []loc.Span{{Start: 2, End: 3}, {Start: 2, End: 7}, unknown, {Start: 2, End: 7}}},
		{name: "punctuation", tokens: []tokenSpan{{ATOM, loc.Span{Start: 2, End: 3}}, {',', loc.Span{Start: 5, End: 6}}}, want: []loc.Span{{Start: 2, End: 3}, {Start: 5, End: 6}, {Start: 2, End: 6}}},
		{name: "invalid leading token", tokens: []tokenSpan{{ATOM, unknown}, {ATOM, loc.Span{Start: 4, End: 5}}}, want: []loc.Span{unknown, {Start: 4, End: 5}, unknown, {Start: 4, End: 5}}},
	}
	parser := yyNewParser()
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			l := &lexer{tokens: tt.tokens}
			if status := parser.Parse(l); status != 0 || l.err != "" {
				t.Fatalf("parse failed: status %d, error %q", status, l.err)
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(l.spans, tt.want) {
				t.Fatalf("spans = %+v, want %+v", l.spans, tt.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
